The '''D-15 Corruption Droid''' was a model of [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] that was used by the [[Dread Host]], the armies of the [[Dread Masters]] during the [[Galactic War]]. D-15 Corruption Droids and similar models were stationed at the [[Dread Fortress]] under the command of the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Corruptor Zero]], and fought to defend the fortress during the [[Dread War]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
D-15 Corruption Droids appear as enemies in the Operation "The Dread Fortress" in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]''.<ref name="TOR" />
